violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. - OBSERVED: BBQ chicken (74f) was stored in walk-in cooler for 2 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to discard the food item. El Bebe (Inspection Date: 09/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: roasted chicken (109-116f) was stored in avantco hot box for about 2 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM reheated the roasted chicken to 181f.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: Bloody Mary (44f) was stored in 2-door cooler (bar) overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the Bloody Mary.

out_items.name: Pasteurized foods used; prohibited foods not offered

violations.title: Raw/Undercooked Animal Foods Prohibited in HSP
violations.observation: The following raw or partially cooked meat, fish, shell eggs, and/or molluscan shellfish offered for sale or service in a facility that serves a highly susceptible population: - OBSERVED: grilled salmon is marked as a food item that may contain raw or under cooked ingredients in kids menu.
violations.corrective_action: In a food service establishment that serves a highly susceptible population, foods may not be served or offered for sale in a ready-to-eat form if the food is a partially cooked animal food such as lightly cooked fish, rare meat, soft cooked eggs, or meringue. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: salmon should be fully cooked for highly susceptible populations. Please revise the kids menu accordingly.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. - OBSERVED: a food employee wiped hands on apron and added cut lime to a dish without washing hands and changing gloves after cooking raw meat on the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS and CFMeducated the food employee.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: - OBSERVED: a food employee rinsed a soiled vegetable slicer and then use it to slice cabbage and carrots to prepare vegetable slaw.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM educated the food employee. Vegetable slaw was discarded.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: - OBSERVED: homemade pickled red cabbage was prepared on 3/19/2026. By the time of inspection, it has been stored in walk-in cooler for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food item.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: - OBSERVED: half-half has been stored in 2-door cooler (bar) for 2 days without proper date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted the CFM to properly label the food item.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: - OBSERVED: both undercooked food items and allergens are identified using the same asterisk on the menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please used different asterisks to identify undercooked food items and allergens on the menu within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: - OBSERVED: a consumer advisory was observed on kids menu.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please remove the consumer advisory from the kids menu and ensure all food items offered on the kids menu are fully cooked.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED: frozen mahi-mahi in intact ROP packaging thawing at room temperature on a storage rack used for storing cleaned utensils.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFM. CFM made a cut in the ROP packaging and relocated the food item to walk-in cooler.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: utensils were stored in a container of stagnant water at room temperature at bar.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: food employee discarded the water.
